summary: Implementation fully matches the T21 plan: packaging/uninstall.sh is self-contained with every documented flag (--dry-run/--non-interactive/--yes/--install-dir/--purge-config/--purge-state/--remove-uv/--all/--shell/--help), all shell reason tokens (CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, UV_REMOVAL_REFUSED_UNOWNED, STATE_CLEANUP_FAILED plus reused install.sh tokens), the platform guard before mutation, the AWF_UNINSTALL_FORCE_INTERACTIVE confirm gate, verbatim-mirrored managed uv/pipx removal with the unmanaged refusal/no-op, marker-gated --remove-uv, the credential-preserving ${AWF_HOME} allowlist (config.yml + service/ only), and the remove_uv->purge_state->uninstall_awf->advisory main ordering. install.sh's bootstrap_uv writes the deterministic ownership marker and documents the AWF_UV_MARKER seam. All six enumerated test modules and the install.sh marker cases exist, plus the additive docs/UNINSTALL.md hosted-lane section. The previously-outstanding gap — missing AWF-owned validation evidence — is now closed: docs/awf-plans/ws_8846dc92df1c4f02929f707b.validation.md records all six section-5 focused-gate commands (`bash -n packaging/uninstall.sh`, `bash -n packaging/install.sh`, `ruff check tests/unit/installer`, `ruff format --check tests/unit/installer`, `pytest tests/unit/installer -q`, `pytest tests/unit/docs/test_public_docs_status.py -q`) as passing, with whole-repo pytest/mypy/OpenAPI/coverage left to AWF/GitHub CI after the agent phase.
